entities.summary: Dhawee Umponmaha, known professionally as Kaopong Sitichuchai, is a Thai former professional Muay Thai fighter and amateur boxer. He is a former Lumpinee Stadium Featherweight Champion and won a silver medal in boxing at the 1984 Summer Olympics in the Light Welterweight division.
